notes.title: 🛠️ Update v0.9 - More interactables, Weapon DPS/Artifact tooltips
notes.notes:
🔥In this update🔥
Added more stage interactables for deeper strategy, DPS tooltips on guns, and artifact tooltips for more clarity, auto-dash and fast level transitions, to get players into the action quickly. A lot of balance tweaks will keep the game more fun and strategic—less RNG and frustrating.



📈 DPS Counter on weapons – compare weapons with ease (you can still see individual stats)

🧠 Hover-to-Read Artifacts – see what your artifacts do anytime

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739234/1faf44e094252148136df632ec25d9b783f52df1.png"]



⚡ Quick Level Transitions – seamless transitions to keep gameplay fluid

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739234/e6fd80e3816210fb95abebceb7152edaf4c7aa34.gif"]



🏛️ New Mid-Stage Interactibles – including sacrifice fountain, artifact tree, and void spike

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739234/e77edf2701f3361533accdeb8d80bbc2ce6a7906.gif"]



🏃 Auto-Dash – ease up some pinkie strain

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739234/39b56ce624312f4328c171a7bce3d0c0e65ee2be.gif"]



Did I write down everything? No! But here's most of it~



Artifacts

🔮 2 new artifacts, 6 artifacts reworked

Bind – elites now have a chance to drop artifacts

new Flame Crown – critical hits burn enemies

new Molten Totem – enemies that hurt you get burned

Snow Globe – saves you from death once, then breaks

Snap Freeze – updated visuals + AoE freeze, longer duration

Frozen Key – freezes all enemies at the start of each stage

Silver Key – gain shield at stage start if unshielded

Buckler – now increases i-frames on hit



Enemy system changes

🌫️ Cloak, when invisible, is hidden from all enemies/bosses

🤠 Outlaw's slow ability now works on all enemies/bosses

👑 Fly Queen – moveset tweaks

❄️ King Yeti – no longer invulnerable in 2nd phase

🕳️ Celestial Enigma - spawns minions in 2nd phase

💀 Bosses now always drop a max HP artifact



Interactables

💀 Traps affect the player and enemies as well

🏛️ Obelisk interactable trades max HP for coins (temporarily)

🏛️ Sacrifice Fountain and Artifact Tree now spawn in stages - both giving artifacts

🏛️ New Void Spike interactable - trade health for coins



Weather

🌪️ Desert Sandstorm – no longer pushes the player, way too annoying

☁️ Weather Effects – Visual effects now active during boss fights



Miscellaneous 

🎨 Updated player and portal sprites

🎯 Rifle now scales with accuracy stat

👥 New/updated NPC dialogue

💥 Ammo chests will now break into ammo when damaged



Next update will most likely have an ascension-like mode, which will add unlockable higher difficulties.

notes.title: Update v0.8 - Boss reworks, burn effects, new guns & items
notes.notes:
To anyone reading this, merry christmas you are COOL AS ****

This is another general improvement update. The main focus was making bosses susceptible to player status effects and abilities. So now all but 1 boss (which I will fix) can be knocked back and slowed. I reworked the jungle boss entirely because of this. Added a burn mechanic, which quickly damages enemies while ticking down it's damage. Added 3 new weapons and 2 new items, mostly related to burn. Added a bunch of other miscellaneous changes below. 

There will be another update very soon to do some visual fx with burn and more.

FULL CHANGELOG:
-Added "Fire Rock" item (chance to burn on hit)
-Added "Hot Knife" item (melee hits burn)
-Added "Flame Pistol" weapon (burns on hit)
-Added "Flame Shotgun" weapon (burns on hit)
-Bosses now bleed for 1% max health, but bleed slower. 
-Complete Jungle boss rework, can now be slowed and knocked back.
-Melee range is larger for all characters, does more damage, and has higher knockback, but is slower.
-Improved melee sound effect.
-Final boss heals at half HP.
-Added slight player movement acceleration.
-Added the burn status effect.
-Added icons to burn and bleed status effects.
-End of level teleporter spawns close to you when level is finished.
-Elites spawn more frequently, and can spawn earlier.
-Elites now drop either ammo, HP, or a weapon.
-Coins disappear after 10 seconds.
-Bullets change color depending on their status effect.
-Fixed some enemies not freezing correctly.
-Changed item unlock conditions for a few items.

Item changes:
-"Cracked horn" procs under 5 hp. (Old - procs under 6 max hp)
-"Cursed flame" decreases accuracy. (Old - decreases damage)
-"Knives" increase melee damage. (Old - increase melee speed)
-"Snowglobe" heals 1 HP at start of stage. (Old - Heal 1 HP at start if stage if under half health)
-"Silver Key" gives 1 armor. (Old - gives 1 HP)
-"Amulet" Increases ability charge rate. (Old - additional max ability slot)
-"Frozen Key" freeze time buffed to 5 seconds. (Old - 4 seconds)

notes.title: Update v0.7.0 - Across the Board
notes.notes:
This is a comprehensive update, with a lot of changes to a lot of systems. For starters, unique ability slots will now recharge when defeating enemies; no more having to scramble for an ammo chest surrounded by enemies. Also, defeating a boss spawns 3 artifacts of your choice, for free! Check out some of the other important changes below~ 


Full Changelog:
-Added weapon tier in form of roman numerals below weapons. (I, II, III, IV).
-Enemies spawn further away from the player on level entrance.
-Improved final boss phase 2 move set.
-Desert crawler's bomb indicators no longer overlap.
-Add flat damage negation to Elementals, and the final boss. (5 damage negation)
-Traps in the Castle area no longer stay active when level is clear.
-Fixed artifact 'Ice Cream' never spawning. (Chance to freeze enemies)
-Artifact 'Brand' is stronger, now applies to all types of damage dealt.
-Artifact 'Blood Money' does more damage. 
-Removed artifact 'Yoyo' for a rework.
-Choosing an artifact from a tree or shop equips it instantly.
-Movement speed artifacts are less jarring to pickup, and more balanced.
-Artifact tree now spawns in boss rooms, giving player 3 choices of a free artifact.
-Player abilities now charge when defeating enemies. Charge amount depends on how strong the enemy is.
-Increased cursor size.
-Added flavor text to loading screen.
-Bug/crash fixes.
-Lag fix when large amount of enemies are on screen.
